summary: Moves anomaly alerts to the new alert experience, adds saved views and quick filters improvements, and fixes bugs including an explorer crash on unsupported queries in the URL.
SigNoz 0.147.0 removes the vulnerable v1 alert-history API endpoints and adds a Telegram alert channel and saved views.
Adds AI queries and heatmaps in dashboards, variables in panel titles, and more onboarding data sources. Trace attributes can now be promoted and indexed.
